name: [unnamed] house and land agent
trade: houses and lands purchased and sold; building lots; houses to let

notice.trade: houses and lands purchased and sold; building lots; houses to let
notice.basis: The advertisement is anonymous: the paper printed the trade and no proprietor, so no person of this record can carry the reading it was compiled from. What is attested here is what the notice itself set in type — “houses and lands purchased and sold; building lots; houses to let” — and nothing beyond it: no keeper is claimed, and the premises and dates of this record stay on their own blocks at the tier the placement policy left them. Bounded by the printing window (printed 1834-05-14), which dates the notice and not the house.

locations.basis: The register resolved no place for this house at the scene date.
locations.limit_reason: No street the model holds. The anchor "Dr. Temple's" names nothing the committed town holds.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1834-05-14, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: This record names nobody the resident layer holds a card for, so there is no person to read a community off. The silence is in the register.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
